name: docsqa-linked-docs-v5-development
task: rank canonical technical-documentation pages and answer real support questions from pinned local evidence

system_setting.evaluation_status: exploratory because this pool was reused during system development
system_setting.publication_test_requirement: evaluate a newly collected disjoint post-freeze cohort once

aspect_rule_optimization.purpose: select one general aspect-construction rule before freezing question-specific aspects; it does not alter evaluated agents
aspect_rule_optimization.implementation: SkillOpt 0.2.0 with a local environment adapter

split.duplicate_policy: duplicate source questions remain in one partition
split.materialization: generated under the ignored rule-optimization run directory

aspect_rule_optimization.validation_gate: the fraction of records with importance-weighted source-answer aspect coverage at least 0.80 must improve
aspect_rule_optimization.test_policy: evaluate once after the rule is frozen; no optimizer feedback from test
aspect_rule_optimization.status: completed; selected rule passed validation and one-time held-out evaluation, and frozen aspects were generated for all 467 normalized records

frozen_retrieval_parameters.graph_fusion: equal-weight RRF over the hybrid and bounded graph rankings

qrel_provenance: distinct in-corpus documentation pages explicitly linked in accepted public support answers
unjudged_policy: zero measured gain; do not claim exhaustive irrelevance
fairness_controls: same language model and non-retrieval tools for agent comparisons
retrieved canonical IDs logged before answer generation
all failures retained in the denominator
